download_rpa_ul_128_model: download the RPA Unlikelihood 128 model for the Parlai Light Whoami task to a given datapath
run_download_function: run the download function to fetch the rpa_ul_128 model version v1.0 into the specified data directory
summarize_download_function: summarize the download function that calls download_with_model_type for the rpa_ul_128 model variant
review_download_integration: review the download function and its integration with the whoami_download utility module
test_download_rpa_ul_128: test the download function by passing a datapath and verifying the rpa_ul_128 model is fetched
